packMeta.name: FleetFlow (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey vehicle fleet and driver logbook: live rego, insurance and licence expiry countdown alerts, vehicle register with automatic odometer syncing from trips, FBT business/personal trip and fuel logbook, workshop maintenance pipeline, and incident register. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
